note: Per-collection rights switch for the fifi.cooking import (docs/EXPORT-FIFI.md section 2, RFC-0009). text: full publishes the family's steps and notes; text: facts publishes only structured facts (names, ingredient lines and quantities, times, nutrition and cost estimates, allergens, source link) and withholds the step text until rights are confirmed in writing. Set export to false to exclude a collection entirely. Decision 2026-10-05: every collection whose content derives from a book or a channel is facts-only.
